one-part.label: Complete a target from one given part
one-part.observed: The remaining occupied target cells must be covered by a connected complement.
one-part.construct: Make the junction visible and vary the footprint. A shorter end or changed bend can leave a gap. Check coverage and collisions after allowed poses.

two-parts.label: Complete a target from two given parts
two-parts.observed: Every given piece constrains the residual cells for the next piece.
two-parts.construct: Design two interlocking given pieces and vary their placement clues. A foil can fit beside one but overlap the other. Require a simultaneous full packing.

interface.label: Distinguish equal-volume interfaces
interface.observed: Equal-count alternatives can disagree on the last raised cell or connection.
interface.construct: Fix the placement of the given rail. Move one riser or bend in a same-count complement; keep other options and camera comparable. Enumerate all permitted poses.
interface.extension: The controlled near/far pair and exact-cover search are local constructions.
